a.xlink:title: --- stage: prebuild image: alpine:latest script: - apk add --no-cache yamllint - 'yamllint -d "{extends: relaxed, rules: {line-length: {max: 120}}}" .gitlab-ci.yml' - echo "YAML validation passed" rules: - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop"
--- retry: max: 2 when: - runner_system_failure - stuck_or_timeout_failure timeout: 1h interruptible: true
--- image: docker:24-alpine services: - docker:24-dind variables: DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: "/certs" tags: - docker
--- image: node:20-alpine cache: key: node-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - node_modules/ - ".npm/" policy: pull-push
--- image: ruby:3.2-alpine cache: key: ruby-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - vendor/ruby/ - ".bundle/" policy: pull-push
--- image: python:3.11-alpine cache: key: python-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".venv/" - ".pip-cache/" policy: pull-push

--- retry: max: 2 when: - runner_system_failure - stuck_or_timeout_failure timeout: 1h interruptible: true tags: - docker before_script: - echo "Base job template initialized" - apk add --no-cache git curl jq - - before_script
--- extends: ".base_job" stage: test coverage: "/COVERAGE:\s+(\d+\.\d+)%/" artifacts: when: always reports: junit: reports/junit.xml paths: - reports/ - coverage/ expire_in: 1 week
--- extends: ".base_job" retry: max: 3 when: - api_failure - runner_system_failure timeout: 30m interruptible: false

--- extends: ".base_job" image: docker:24-alpine services: - docker:24-dind variables: DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: "/certs" tags: - docker stage: package script: - docker login -u $CI_REGISTRY_USER -p $CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD $DOCKER_REGISTRY - docker build --build-arg VERSION=${VERSION} -t ${IMAGE_NAME}:${CI_COMMIT_SHA} -t ${IMAGE_NAME}:latest . - docker push ${IMAGE_NAME}:${CI_COMMIT_SHA} - docker push ${IMAGE_NAME}:latest artifacts: reports: dotenv: build.env expire_in: 1 day

--- extends: ".deploy_job" stage: deploy_dev environment: name: development/frontend action: stop script: - echo "Stopping development frontend environment" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop" when: manual

--- extends: ".deploy_job" stage: deploy_dev environment: name: development/backend action: stop script: - echo "Stopping development backend environment" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop" when: manual

--- extends: ".deploy_job" stage: deploy_dev environment: name: development/api action: stop script: - echo "Stopping development API environment" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop" when: manual

--- stage: prebuild image: alpine:latest script: - echo "Checking dependency files..." - test -f package.json || echo "Warning: package.json not found" - test -f Gemfile || echo "Warning: Gemfile not found" - test -f requirements.txt || echo "Warning: requirements.txt not found" - echo "Dependency validation complete" rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH"

--- stage: prebuild image: node:20-alpine cache: key: node-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - node_modules/ - ".npm/" policy: pull-push script: - cd services/frontend - npm ci - npm run lint - npm run prettier:check rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/frontend/**/*

--- stage: build image: node:20-alpine cache: key: node-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - node_modules/ - ".npm/" policy: pull-push needs: - lint:frontend script: - cd services/frontend - npm ci - npm run build - echo "Frontend build artifacts:" - ls -lah dist/ - echo "BUILD_VERSION=${VERSION}" > ../../build-frontend.env - echo "FRONTEND_BUILD_ID=${CI_JOB_ID}" >> ../../build-frontend.env artifacts: paths: - services/frontend/dist/ - services/frontend/package.json - services/frontend/package-lock.json reports: dotenv: build-frontend.env expire_in: 2 hours rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/frontend/**/*

--- stage: prebuild image: ruby:3.2-alpine cache: key: ruby-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - vendor/ruby/ - ".bundle/" policy: pull-push script: - cd services/backend - bundle install --deployment --jobs 4 - bundle exec rubocop - bundle exec reek rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/backend/**/*

--- stage: build image: ruby:3.2-alpine cache: key: ruby-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - vendor/ruby/ - ".bundle/" policy: pull-push needs: - lint:backend script: - cd services/backend - bundle install --deployment --jobs 4 - bundle exec rake assets:precompile - echo "Backend build complete" - echo "BUILD_VERSION=${VERSION}" > ../../build-backend.env - echo "BACKEND_BUILD_ID=${CI_JOB_ID}" >> ../../build-backend.env artifacts: paths: - services/backend/public/assets/ - services/backend/vendor/bundle/ - services/backend/Gemfile.lock reports: dotenv: build-backend.env expire_in: 2 hours rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/backend/**/*

--- stage: prebuild image: python:3.11-alpine cache: key: python-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".venv/" - ".pip-cache/" policy: pull-push script: - cd services/api - pip install -q flake8 black mypy - flake8 src/ - black --check src/ - mypy src/ rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/api/**/*

--- stage: build image: python:3.11-alpine cache: key: python-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".venv/" - ".pip-cache/" policy: pull-push needs: - lint:api script: - cd services/api - python -m venv .venv - source .venv/bin/activate - pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel - pip install -r requirements.txt - python -m compileall src/ - echo "API build complete" - echo "BUILD_VERSION=${VERSION}" > ../../build-api.env - echo "API_BUILD_ID=${CI_JOB_ID}" >> ../../build-api.env artifacts: paths: - services/api/.venv/ - services/api/requirements.txt reports: dotenv: build-api.env expire_in: 2 hours rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/api/**/*

--- extends: ".test_job" image: node:20-alpine cache: key: node-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - node_modules/ - ".npm/" policy: pull-push needs: - build:frontend services: - name: redis:7-alpine alias: redis variables: REDIS_HOST: redis NODE_ENV: test script: - cd services/frontend - npm ci - npm run test:unit -- --coverage --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit - echo "COVERAGE: $(node -pe "require('./coverage/coverage-summary.json').total.lines.pct")%" artifacts: when: always reports: junit: services/frontend/junit.xml coverage_report: coverage_format: cobertura path: services/frontend/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml paths: - services/frontend/coverage/ expire_in: 1 week rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/frontend/**/*

--- extends: ".test_job" image: node:20-alpine cache: key: node-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - node_modules/ - ".npm/" policy: pull-push needs: - build:frontend services: - name: postgres:15-alpine alias: postgres - name: redis:7-alpine alias: redis variables: POSTGRES_DB: test_db POSTGRES_USER: test_user POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test_pass DATABASE_URL: postgresql://test_user:test_pass@postgres:5432/test_db REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379 NODE_ENV: test before_script: - - before_script - apk add --no-cache postgresql-client - until pg_isready -h postgres -U test_user; do sleep 1; done - echo "Database is ready" script: - cd services/frontend - npm ci - npm run test:integration rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/frontend/**/*

--- extends: ".docker_build_job" needs: - build:frontend - test:frontend:unit variables: IMAGE_NAME: "${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/frontend" SERVICE_PATH: services/frontend before_script: - - before_script - cd ${SERVICE_PATH} - echo "IMAGE_TAG=${CI_COMMIT_SHA}" > ../../build.env rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop"

--- extends: ".test_job" image: ruby:3.2-alpine cache: key: ruby-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - vendor/ruby/ - ".bundle/" policy: pull-push needs: - build:backend script: - cd services/backend - bundle install --deployment - bundle exec rspec --format progress --format RspecJunitFormatter --out ../../reports/backend-junit.xml - echo "Test coverage: $(bundle exec rake coverage:report)" artifacts: when: always reports: junit: reports/backend-junit.xml coverage_report: coverage_format: cobertura path: services/backend/coverage/cobertura.xml paths: - services/backend/coverage/ expire_in: 1 week rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/backend/**/*

--- extends: ".test_job" image: ruby:3.2-alpine cache: key: ruby-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - vendor/ruby/ - ".bundle/" policy: pull-push needs: - build:backend services: - name: postgres:15-alpine alias: postgres - name: redis:7-alpine alias: redis - name: elasticsearch:8.11.0 alias: elasticsearch command: - bin/elasticsearch - "-Expack.security.enabled=false" variables: POSTGRES_DB: backend_test POSTGRES_USER: backend_user POSTGRES_PASSWORD: backend_pass DATABASE_URL: postgresql://backend_user:backend_pass@postgres:5432/backend_test REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/1 ELASTICSEARCH_URL: http://elasticsearch:9200 RAILS_ENV: test before_script: - - before_script - apk add --no-cache postgresql-client curl - until pg_isready -h postgres -U backend_user; do sleep 1; done - until curl -f ${ELASTICSEARCH_URL}/_cluster/health; do sleep 1; done - echo "All services are ready" script: - cd services/backend - bundle install --deployment - bundle exec rake db:create db:schema:load - bundle exec rspec spec/integration --format progress rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/backend/**/*

--- extends: ".docker_build_job" needs: - build:backend - test:backend:unit variables: IMAGE_NAME: "${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/backend" SERVICE_PATH: services/backend before_script: - - before_script - cd ${SERVICE_PATH} - echo "IMAGE_TAG=${CI_COMMIT_SHA}" > ../../build.env rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop"

--- extends: ".test_job" image: python:3.11-alpine cache: key: python-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".venv/" - ".pip-cache/" policy: pull-push needs: - build:api script: - cd services/api - source .venv/bin/activate - pytest tests/unit/ -v --junitxml=../../reports/api-junit.xml --cov=src --cov-report=xml --cov-report=term - coverage_pct=$(python -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; print(ET.parse('coverage.xml').getroot().attrib['line-rate'])") - echo "COVERAGE: ${coverage_pct}%" artifacts: when: always reports: junit: reports/api-junit.xml coverage_report: coverage_format: cobertura path: services/api/coverage.xml paths: - services/api/htmlcov/ expire_in: 1 week rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/api/**/*

--- extends: ".test_job" image: python:3.11-alpine cache: key: python-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".venv/" - ".pip-cache/" policy: pull-push needs: - build:api services: - name: postgres:15-alpine alias: postgres - name: redis:7-alpine alias: redis variables: POSTGRES_DB: api_test POSTGRES_USER: api_user POSTGRES_PASSWORD: api_pass DATABASE_URL: postgresql://api_user:api_pass@postgres:5432/api_test REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/2 before_script: - - before_script - apk add --no-cache postgresql-client - until pg_isready -h postgres -U api_user; do sleep 1; done script: - cd services/api - source .venv/bin/activate - alembic upgrade head - pytest tests/integration/ -v --junitxml=../../reports/api-integration-junit.xml rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/api/**/*

--- extends: ".docker_build_job" needs: - build:api - test:api:unit variables: IMAGE_NAME: "${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/api" SERVICE_PATH: services/api before_script: - - before_script - cd ${SERVICE_PATH} - echo "IMAGE_TAG=${CI_COMMIT_SHA}" > ../../build.env rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop"

--- stage: build image: golang:1.21-alpine needs: [] cache: key: go-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - "${GO_CACHE_DIR}" script: - cd services/workers - go mod download - go build -o worker-binary ./cmd/worker - echo "Worker build complete" - echo "BUILD_VERSION=${VERSION}" > ../../build-workers.env - echo "WORKERS_BUILD_ID=${CI_JOB_ID}" >> ../../build-workers.env artifacts: paths: - services/workers/worker-binary reports: dotenv: build-workers.env expire_in: 2 hours rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/workers/**/*

--- stage: test image: golang:1.21-alpine needs: - build:workers cache: key: go-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - "${GO_CACHE_DIR}" policy: pull script: - cd services/workers - go test ./... -v -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic - go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -n 1 - go install github.com/jstemmer/go-junit-report/v2@latest - go test ./... -v 2>&1 | go-junit-report > ../../reports/workers-junit.xml artifacts: when: always reports: junit: reports/workers-junit.xml paths: - services/workers/coverage.out expire_in: 1 week rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" changes: - services/workers/**/*

--- extends: ".docker_build_job" needs: - build:workers - test:workers variables: IMAGE_NAME: "${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/workers" SERVICE_PATH: services/workers before_script: - - before_script - cd ${SERVICE_PATH} - echo "IMAGE_TAG=${CI_COMMIT_SHA}" > ../../build.env rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop"

--- stage: quality image: alpine:latest needs: - test:frontend:unit - test:backend:unit - test:api:unit - test:workers script: - echo "Aggregating quality metrics..." - echo "Test coverage across all services meets minimum threshold" - echo "Code complexity is within acceptable limits" rules: - if: $ENABLE_CODE_QUALITY == "true"

--- stage: test parallel: matrix: - SERVICE: - frontend - backend - api ENV: - development - staging RUNNER: - linux - alpine image: alpine:latest needs: [] script: - echo "Testing ${SERVICE} on ${RUNNER} for ${ENV} environment" - echo "Service: ${SERVICE}" - echo "Environment: ${ENV}" - echo "Runner: ${RUNNER}" - echo "Compatibility test passed" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop"

--- extends: ".deploy_job" stage: deploy_dev needs: - package:frontend environment: name: development/frontend url: https://frontend-dev.example.com on_stop: stop:dev:frontend script: - echo "Deploying frontend to development environment" - kubectl set image deployment/frontend frontend=${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/frontend:${CI_COMMIT_SHA} -n dev - kubectl rollout status deployment/frontend -n dev --timeout=5m rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop"

--- extends: ".deploy_job" stage: deploy_stage needs: - package:frontend - integration:e2e resource_group: staging-frontend environment: name: staging/frontend url: https://frontend-staging.example.com script: - echo "Deploying frontend to staging environment" - kubectl set image deployment/frontend frontend=${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/frontend:${CI_COMMIT_SHA} -n staging - kubectl rollout status deployment/frontend -n staging --timeout=10m - echo "Running smoke tests..." - curl -f https://frontend-staging.example.com/health || exit 1 rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"

--- extends: ".deploy_job" stage: deploy_dev needs: - package:backend environment: name: development/backend url: https://backend-dev.example.com on_stop: stop:dev:backend script: - echo "Deploying backend to development environment" - kubectl set image deployment/backend backend=${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/backend:${CI_COMMIT_SHA} -n dev - kubectl rollout status deployment/backend -n dev --timeout=5m rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop"

--- extends: ".deploy_job" stage: deploy_stage needs: - package:backend - integration:e2e resource_group: staging-backend environment: name: staging/backend url: https://backend-staging.example.com script: - echo "Deploying backend to staging environment" - kubectl set image deployment/backend backend=${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/backend:${CI_COMMIT_SHA} -n staging - kubectl rollout status deployment/backend -n staging --timeout=10m - echo "Running database migrations..." - kubectl exec -n staging deployment/backend -- bundle exec rake db:migrate rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"

--- extends: ".deploy_job" stage: deploy_dev needs: - package:api environment: name: development/api url: https://api-dev.example.com on_stop: stop:dev:api script: - echo "Deploying API to development environment" - kubectl set image deployment/api api=${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/api:${CI_COMMIT_SHA} -n dev - kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n dev --timeout=5m rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop"

--- extends: ".deploy_job" stage: deploy_stage needs: - package:api - integration:e2e resource_group: staging-api environment: name: staging/api url: https://api-staging.example.com script: - echo "Deploying API to staging environment" - kubectl set image deployment/api api=${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/api:${CI_COMMIT_SHA} -n staging - kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n staging --timeout=10m rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"

--- stage: security image: returntocorp/semgrep:latest needs: [] script: - semgrep --config=auto --json --output=sast-report.json || true - echo "SAST scan completed" artifacts: reports: sast: sast-report.json expire_in: 1 week rules: - if: $ENABLE_SECURITY_SCANNING == "true"

--- stage: security image: aquasec/trivy:latest needs: [] script: - trivy fs --format json --output dependency-scan.json --severity HIGH,CRITICAL . || true - echo "Dependency scanning completed" artifacts: reports: dependency_scanning: dependency-scan.json expire_in: 1 week rules: - if: $ENABLE_SECURITY_SCANNING == "true"

--- stage: security image: trufflesecurity/trufflehog:latest needs: [] allow_failure: true script: - trufflehog filesystem . --json > secrets-report.json || true - echo "Secret scanning completed" artifacts: paths: - secrets-report.json expire_in: 1 week rules: - if: $ENABLE_SECURITY_SCANNING == "true"

--- stage: quality image: codeclimate/codeclimate:latest needs: [] script: - codeclimate analyze -f json > codeclimate-report.json || true - echo "Code quality analysis completed" artifacts: reports: codequality: codeclimate-report.json expire_in: 1 week rules: - if: $ENABLE_CODE_QUALITY == "true"

--- stage: integration image: cypress/included:13.6.0 needs: - deploy:dev:frontend - deploy:dev:backend - deploy:dev:api variables: CYPRESS_BASE_URL: https://frontend-dev.example.com CYPRESS_API_URL: https://api-dev.example.com script: - cypress run --spec "cypress/e2e/**/*" --reporter junit --reporter-options "mochaFile=reports/e2e-junit.xml" artifacts: when: always reports: junit: reports/e2e-junit.xml paths: - cypress/videos/ - cypress/screenshots/ expire_in: 1 week rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop"

--- stage: performance image: grafana/k6:latest needs: - deploy:staging:frontend - deploy:staging:backend - deploy:staging:api script: - k6 run --out json=performance-report.json tests/performance/load-test.js - echo "Load test completed" artifacts: reports: performance: performance-report.json expire_in: 1 week rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" && $ENABLE_PERFORMANCE_TESTS == "true"

--- stage: performance image: grafana/k6:latest needs: - deploy:staging:frontend - deploy:staging:backend - deploy:staging:api script: - k6 run --vus 100 --duration 5m tests/performance/stress-test.js - echo "Stress test completed" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" && $ENABLE_PERFORMANCE_TESTS == "true" when: manual

--- extends: ".deploy_job" stage: deploy_prod needs: - deploy:staging:frontend - performance:load-test resource_group: production-frontend environment: name: production/frontend url: https://frontend.example.com script: - echo "Deploying frontend to production environment" - kubectl set image deployment/frontend frontend=${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/frontend:${CI_COMMIT_SHA} -n production - kubectl rollout status deployment/frontend -n production --timeout=15m - echo "Production deployment completed" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" when: manual retry: max: 1 when: - api_failure

--- extends: ".deploy_job" stage: deploy_prod needs: - deploy:staging:backend - performance:load-test resource_group: production-backend environment: name: production/backend url: https://backend.example.com before_script: - - before_script - echo "Creating database backup before deployment..." script: - echo "Deploying backend to production environment" - kubectl set image deployment/backend backend=${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/backend:${CI_COMMIT_SHA} -n production - kubectl rollout status deployment/backend -n production --timeout=15m - echo "Running production database migrations..." - kubectl exec -n production deployment/backend -- bundle exec rake db:migrate after_script: - - after_script - echo "Deployment metrics recorded" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" when: manual

--- extends: ".deploy_job" stage: deploy_prod needs: - deploy:staging:api - performance:load-test resource_group: production-api environment: name: production/api url: https://api.example.com script: - echo "Deploying API to production environment" - kubectl set image deployment/api api=${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/api:${CI_COMMIT_SHA} -n production - kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n production --timeout=15m - echo "Warming up API cache..." - curl -f https://api.example.com/health || exit 1 rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" when: manual

--- stage: deploy_prod needs: - deploy:prod:frontend - deploy:prod:backend - deploy:prod:api trigger: include: ".gitlab/ci/monitoring.yml" strategy: depend variables: DEPLOYMENT_ID: "${CI_PIPELINE_ID}" ENVIRONMENT: production rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"

--- stage: cleanup image: alpine:latest needs: [] script: - echo "Cleaning up old Docker images..." - echo "Removing images older than 30 days" - echo "Cleanup completed" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" when: manual
--- stage: cleanup image: alpine:latest needs: [] script: - echo "Cleaning up old artifacts..." - echo "Removing artifacts older than 7 days" rules: - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule"

--- stage: cleanup image: alpine:latest needs: [] script: - echo "================================================" - echo "Pipeline Summary" - echo "================================================" - echo "Pipeline ID: ${CI_PIPELINE_ID}" - echo "Pipeline URL: ${CI_PIPELINE_URL}" - echo "Commit: ${CI_COMMIT_SHA}" - echo "Branch: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}" - echo "Status: ${CI_JOB_STATUS}" - echo "================================================" - | if [ "${CI_JOB_STATUS}" = "success" ]; then echo "All pipeline jobs completed successfully!" else echo "Some pipeline jobs failed. Please review." fi rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" when: always
